rules.statement: A person claiming compensation for improvements must show reasonable grounds to think they had some right of ownership in the land.
rules.supporting_quote: "Before a person can claim compensation for improvements effected upon a land on the ground that he made the improvements as a bona fide possessor of the land he must show that he had reasonable or probable grounds to think that he had some right of ownership in the land."

meta.parties: Anglo Ceylon and General Estates Co., Ltd. v. Abusalie
